contextDefinition: All empirical percentiles and breadth values use only the contemporaneous completed eligible leader set at that cutoff; no future cross-section is used.

candidates.rules: Positive 30m and 60m returns; contemporaneous leader-set percentiles at least 65% for 30m return and volume acceleration and at least 50% for 30m-return/volume-ratio efficiency; completed trigger buyer share at least 55% and close in the upper 40% of its range.

At most half of the contemporaneous leader set has positive 30m return, while the candidate is at or above the 80th percentile for 30m return and 65th percentile for return/volume efficiency, has positive 30m and 60m returns, and completed trigger buyer share at least 55%.

At least 60% of the contemporaneous leader set has positive 30m return; six completed minutes contain at least four positive close-to-close steps, finish above the first open, hold the reference on the final three closes, have quote-weighted buyer share at least 52%, and no one positive return or candle range dominates the window.
